desc:
Welcome to Would You Rather: School Tower! 🏫👋

Climb the tower by choosing between two doors every stage 🚪
Each choice changes your school life… sometimes it helps, sometimes it makes everything worse 😭

Get different school items, backpacks, hairstyles, accessories, classes, and more to build your ultimate student look 📚✨
Or get trolled with the weirdest combo possible 🫢

Every run feels different with MILLIONS of combinations to discover 🎲

Make it to the top and see how your final school style turns out 🏆
Then compare with your friends and see who became the coolest student 😆

Like the game 👍 and join the Group for extra perks 🎁
